Whitepaper: Inpinity

Version 3.1 – November 2026

1. Introduction

Inpinity is an on-chain ecosystem on Base (Ethereum L2) that combines NFT ownership, gameplay loops and a long-term plan to bring everything into a UE5 game world.

The ecosystem is live through four web apps: MintMapGamePhircle and evolves step-by-step into Inpinity City (a persistent upgrade/crafting layer) and later a full Unreal Engine 5 version of the game.

Important: Always verify addresses and interact only through the official website: https://inpinity.online.

3. The On-Chain Game: Pyramid Blocks, Resources & Combat

The first live module of Inpinity is the Pi-Phi Pyramid: a grid of block NFTs with fixed coordinates (Row/Col). Each block can be minted, revealed to unlock its Pi/Phi digits (rarity), then used for farming, defense, and pirate attacks.

3.1 Core Contracts (current)

3.3 Gameplay Loop

  1. Mint a block at fixed coordinates (Row/Col).
  2. Reveal the block to unlock Pi/Phi digits (rarity).
  3. Farm to generate ERC-1155 resources.
  4. Protect your block with Mercenary V4.
  5. Attack other blocks using Pirates V6 and execute after cooldown.
  6. Use resources for upgrades and the upcoming Inpinity City layer.

3.4 Phircle — The Pyramid as a Circle NEW

Phircle is the visual and interaction evolution of the Pyramid Map. Instead of a triangular grid, the entire 10,000-block pyramid is rendered as a living circle — with the tip at the center and all 100 rings wrapped around it following mathematical constants π (pi) and φ (phi).

🌀
Phircle is live — same contracts, same blocks, same rules — but a completely new perspective on the pyramid. Explore it now at inpinity.online/phircle.
🌀 Open Phircle

What Phircle adds to the ecosystem

  • Unified interaction layer: every block action (mint, reveal, farm, claim, protect, attack, execute) is accessible directly from the circular view — no page switches needed.
  • Visual attack rays: active pirate attacks are drawn as animated red beams from attacker to target, with a live countdown ring on the target block.
  • Profit Predictor: before launching an attack, Phircle estimates the steal amount based on target rarity, chosen resource, and protection level — turning every attack into an informed decision.
  • Attack History Vault: all executed, cancelled and expired attacks are kept in a searchable history, with stolen amounts per raid.
  • War Room layer: a dedicated view that highlights only critical blocks — your unprotected high-rarity blocks and any block currently under attack.
  • Quantum Freeze: pausing the view (Space or button) triggers an "explosion" that spreads the rings apart and zooms in, allowing precise selection on mobile.
  • Deep linking: every block has a shareable URL (#block/1234) that opens directly to that block's Phircle detail.
  • Live Activity Feed: real-time events (attacks, executes, mints, reveals) streamed in a panel on the right.
  • Owner Aura & Ghost Lines: your own blocks are highlighted with a cyan aura and connected as a constellation; when an attacker is selected, a dashed ghost line previews the attack path.

Why π and φ?

The pyramid is not random — every block's rarity is determined by mathematical properties derived from the digits of π and φ (see Mathematical Rarity Proof in the Map). Phircle makes those symmetries visible: mirrored matches along the 0-axis, Pi-digit equals Phi-digit coincidences, and Fibonacci-style ring spacing are all drawn using the same constants. What is computed on-chain is now also shown on-screen.

How Phircle relates to other apps

AppPurposeBest for
Mint Create new blocks Getting your first block
Game Dashboard Manage blocks & detailed panels (protection, boosts, exchange) Deep management & portfolio review
Pyramid Map Classic 2D triangular view Traditional grid navigation
Phircle Circular π-φ view with all interactions Fast decisions, attacks, and overview
Staking Earn passive INPI Passive income

Phircle does not introduce new contracts, new tokens, or new rules. It is purely a new view of the same on-chain reality — but engineered so that strategy, attacks and rare-block hunting become visually intuitive.

7. Roadmap

Two layers: (A) Live Web On-Chain Module (already playable) and (B) The UE5 Game World (expansion layer that uses the same on-chain ownership).

7.1 Roadmap Table

PhaseFocusDeliverables
Now (V6 + Mercenary V4) Stabilize & polish the live Pyramid module V6 farming + V6 pirates + Mercenary V4 live in Game/Map, improved UI/UX, clearer economy display, better resource visualization, attack execution clarity, and contract transparency.
Phircle View (Live) New circular view of the pyramid
  • Phircle live with all interactions unified: attack rays, profit predictor, war room, history vault
  • Quantum Freeze, deep linking, live activity feed
  • Owner aura & ghost lines on top of the same on-chain data
Inpinity City (Alpha) Persistent "upgrade/crafting" layer
  • City slots tied to blocks (buildings/upgrades use resources)
  • Resource sinks (upgrade paths that stabilize inflation)
  • Crafting & progression (using ERC-1155 resources)
  • Partner mechanics (⭐ blocks unlock special blueprints / boosts)
Economy Expansion More depth, less "flat farming" Boosts, time-based events, limited drops, seasonal modifiers, balancing passes, and new resource utility (construction, defense, city modules).
UE5 Version (Prototype) Bring the on-chain world into Unreal Engine 5
  • UE5 client prototype that reads ownership (wallet login) + loads player city data
  • Visual representation of blocks/city modules and resources
  • Deterministic "seed/DNA" systems for consistent visuals
UE5 Version (Playable Alpha) Gameplay in 3D (strategy + exploration) City gameplay loop in UE5: build/upgrade, defend, missions/quests, and on-chain sync points (claims, upgrades, raids).
UE5 Version (Multiplayer & Scale) Social + economy scale-out Multiplayer features, shared hubs, trading UX, tournaments/events, performance improvements and long-term content cadence.

7.2 Inpinity City: Design Goals

  • Make resources meaningful: resources become building materials, not only collectibles.
  • Long-term progression: upgrades have tiers, dependencies, and strategic choices.
  • Economy health: sinks/fees/upgrades prevent runaway inflation.
  • Partner blocks: special routes for collaborations and rare content.

7.3 UE5 Game: Why Unreal?

  • Visual world: your on-chain assets become a playable space.
  • Deep gameplay: strategy + exploration + crafting layers are easier to deliver in UE5.
  • Future-proof: web stays as lightweight dashboard, UE5 becomes the "main game client".

8. Ecosystem Partners
